title: serving-runtime daily scratchpad
content:
Quick notes for 2026-03-20

Context: triage and perf follow-ups after yesterday's canary. Observed higher p99 tail on 8k seq on A100s. Suspect kernel selection + batching regression after kernel dispatch change (PR 482).

Top priority:
- Reproduce p99 locally with stress harness (use --seq-len 8192, --batch 1..8). If repro, capture perf counters and nvprof trace.
- Re-check kernel selection heuristics: fallback to slower kernel for some attention sizes? Add verbose logging to kernel_selector.
- Validate KV-cache warmup logic: some requests are missing prefix hits causing full decode cost.

Yesterday findings summary:
- Canary metrics: overall throughput ok but p99 spiked from 220ms -> 560ms for 8k sequences (small fraction of requests).
- Flamegraphs point to attention kernel dispatch and memcpy hotspots.
- PR 482 changed kernel preference ordering to favor tiled attention for medium heads; might misclassify some shapes.

Immediate TODOs (me):
- [ ] Run stress harness on staging-gpu-3 09:00-10:30 (note: reserve node via infra ticket).
- [ ] Add extra logs in kernel_selector: log model name, layer idx, seq_len, heads, kv_dim, chosen_kernel_id. Keep log level debug and gate with env KERNEL_DEBUG=1.
- [ ] Add unit test for attention-shape mapping with edge cases (seq 4096-16384, heads 8/16).
- [ ] Bisect PR 482 locally: checkout commit before change, run small perf run, then reapply patch to isolate offending hunk.
- [ ] Open follow-up PR to add fallback timer: if tiled kernel takes > X ms for a layer, fallback to baseline and record metric.

Notes to share in triage call:
- Probable root cause: mis-routed kernel path for large sequence, leading to tile sizes that cause extra memcpy and synchronization.
- Short-term mitigation: restrict tiled kernel to seq_len <= 4096 until we add robust perf guard.
- Long-term: richer kernel cost model fed from empirical perf matrix per hw type.

Commands I will run today:
- ./tools/stress_harness --model gpt-7b --seq-len 8192 --batch 1 --duration 600 --log perf.out
- python3 infra/node_reserve.py --node staging-gpu-3 --until 11:00
- nvprof --profile-from-start off --metrics all --output-profile nvprof.out 

Observations to capture if repro:
- kernel_selector logs (new debug)
- nvprof timeline showing memcpy vs kernel exec
- running GPU utilization + SM stall reasons
- stack dumps for threads waiting on CUDA events

Open tickets and next steps:
- INF-3451: p99 regression tracking (linked). Add initial findings by EOD. Assigned to me + Priya.
- LR-987: follow-up to improve kernel selection heuristics (owner: Diego).

Random notes / ideas:
- Could we add lightweight microbenchmarks that run on node startup to populate a per-node kernel cost table? Would speed up dispatch decisions. Keep under 2 minutes.
- Consider adding a 'safe-mode' env var for Dedicated pools that disables aggressive kernels for SLA critical customers.

Personal sync reminders:
- Pair with Priya 11:30 to review logs and decide short-term limit.
- Block 13:00-14:30 to implement kernel logs + unit tests.

Scratch pad end.
